verdict.rationale: Stripe docs confirm payouts are tracked with expected deposit dates (stripe-docs-34, stripe-docs-52) and the platform exposes a general API (keys, idempotency, versioning) plus an MCP server letting AI agents call the Stripe API (stripe-docs-13, stripe-docs-55, stripe-probe-4), which would support pulling payout data programmatically. However, there's no direct evidence of a balance-transaction API or reconciliation workflow/tooling specifically for matching bank deposits to underlying charges, so the exact reconciliation use case is only inferable, not demonstrated.
